title: Compare classifiers using paired evidence
promptMarkdown: On400 independent test cases, modelA is correct on340, B on348. Their paired table is: both correct328; A-only correct12; B-only correct20; both wrong40. Calculate each accuracy, their difference and the estimated standard error of the mean paired difference D=B_correct−A_correct using the empirical plug-in variance with denominator400. Compare with a calculation that incorrectly assumes independent model accuracies. Explain how200 duplicate pairs of the same underlying cases would change the interpretation, without inventing an exact effective sample size for unspecified dependence.
hintLadder: Compute its second moment before subtracting squared mean.
A group count is not automatically an effective sample size without a dependence model.
